_comment: Text preview (owner, 2026-10-23): extract_text saves the text as <name>.txt, and the terminal shows a short preview of it, never the whole text: the first five non-empty lines, each without trailing spaces, then "… N more lines" ("line" for one) when there are more; an empty text is "(no text)". Python skills/documents/python/tests/test_text_preview_parity.py, Rust skills/documents/native/tests/text_preview_parity.rs.
